title: Encounter & conquest
description: European claims preceded coercive colonization. Indigenous Caribbean societies were diverse, and their descendants survive today.

title: The plantation frontier
description: Sugar, trade and enslaved labour made small islands prizes in European imperial competition. Colonial footholds spread through Indigenous resistance.

title: Seven Years’ War
description: The war’s Caribbean conquests were rearranged at Paris: France recovered its sugar islands while Britain acquired Grenada, Dominica, Saint Vincent and Tobago.

title: War beyond America
description: The American Revolutionary War became an Atlantic conflict. France, Spain and the Netherlands fought Britain across the Caribbean.

title: Revolution & emancipation
description: The Haitian Revolution overthrew slavery and colonial rule. European war and the struggle for emancipation reshaped neighbouring islands.

title: Napoleonic Wars
description: British naval power seized French, Dutch and Danish colonies. Peace treaties often preceded actual handovers by years.

title: The independence generation
description: Most British island colonies became sovereign states. Several territories retained constitutional connections to European powers and the United States.
